strings.gui.deny_defaults_list:
Built-in list (read-only):
• SSH private keys: id_rsa, id_ed25519, id_ecdsa, id_dsa (.pub stays readable)
• Windows Credential Manager, Vault and DPAPI keys: %APPDATA%\Microsoft\Credentials, Protect, Vault
• Browser passwords and cookies: Login Data, Cookies, logins.json, key4.db, cookies.sqlite
• Git and GitHub CLI tokens: .git-credentials, gh\hosts.yml
• Dev Space Go's own config and state, so the AI cannot change its own permissions
In "only listed folders" mode the list is broader (also .aws, .gnupg, .git/config, browser profiles, system folders).
